name: circle-properties
description: This library allows obtaining the properties of a geometric circle from any of its measurements.

scripts.build-package: npm run transpile && npm run generate-types && node tasks/prepare-package.js
scripts.clean: rm -rf build && rm -rf node_modules && rm package-lock.json && npm cache clean -f && npm cache verify
scripts.pre-transpile: shx rm -rf build/circle-properties && shx mkdir -p build/circle-properties && shx cp -rf src build/circle-properties/src
